info.description: The headless API is designed for implementing your own store frontend with the data of your store. You are able to call the Headless API directly from a web browser (such as within an SPA), from a backend server, or in-game GUIs.
info.title: Tebex Headless API

get.description:
Fetches a basket's auth URL. The player should be directed here in order for them to authorize their account.
When complete, they will be returned to the provided `returnUrl` and the basket will be authorized from that moment onwards.

parameters.description: The URL you would like to redirect the user to after successful basket authentication.
parameters.name: returnUrl

200.description: Successful response returns the auth provider options and URLs of the sign-in link.

422.description: The provided webstore ID or basket ID is invalid.

put.description:
Populates a dynamic category with custom packages for the given basket. Dynamic categories are created in the creator panel with the type `dynamic`, and are typically populated in response to a `basket.authenticated` webhook.

Once created, the packages can be fetched using the category endpoints with both `includePackages=1` and `basketIdent` provided.

200.description: Successful response confirms the dynamic packages were created.

422.description: The provided request is invalid. The error response will include detail as to which parameter failed validation.

put.summary: Add packages to a dynamic category for a basket.

get.description: Gets all categories from a webstore. This does not include package information. To include package information, add `?includePackages=1` to the URL.

200.description: Successful response returns a list of category information.

get.description:
Gets all categories from a webstore including packages. When `basketIdent` is provided, dynamic categories are populated with the packages associated with that basket.

If a basket identifier is not provided, dynamic categories will be empty as the basket is required to relate packages to the category.

200.description: Successful response returns a list of category information.

get.description: Gets information about a category and returns the packages in that category.

parameters.description: The ID or slug of the category to fetch.
parameters.name: categoryId

200.description: Successful response returns the category without package information.

get.description: Gets information about a category and returns the packages in that category.

200.description: Successful response returns the category with package information.

get.summary: Get a category with all packages

get.description:
Gets information about a category and returns the packages in that category. When the category is dynamic and `basketIdent` is provided, the category is populated with the packages associated with that basket.

If a basket identifier is not provided, a dynamic category will be empty as the basket is required to relate packages to the category.

parameters.description: The ID or slug of the category to fetch.
parameters.name: categoryId

200.description: Successful response returns the category with package information.

get.summary: Gets a specific category including packages, populating a dynamic category for the given basket.

get.description:
Gets a package from a webstore by its ID or slug.

Note: this endpoint does not support packages belonging to dynamic categories. Use the category endpoints with `includePackages=1` and `basketIdent` to fetch dynamic packages.

200.description: Successful response returns the package information.

get.description:
Gets all packages from a webstore.

Note: this endpoint does not support packages belonging to dynamic categories. Use the category endpoints with `includePackages=1` and `basketIdent` to fetch dynamic packages.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.  It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

status.description: The HTTP status code gen by the origin server for the occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. It may or may not yield further information if dereferenced

creator_code.description: The creator code is used to share a percentage of the payment with another party. See more about creator codes at https://docs.tebex.io/creators/tebex-control-panel/engagement/creator-codes

payment.description: The `links.payment` property is only returned if the basket has been paid for and a payment exists with the `complete`,`refund`, or `chargeback` status.

checkout.description: The `links.checkout` property is only returned if the basket has not been paid, and is the URL to send the customer to make payment

slug.description: Short identifier slug for the category

tiered.description: True if this is a tiered category

packages.description: Packages within the category. For dynamic categories, packages use the `DynamicPackage` shape and are only populated when a `basketIdent` is provided.

order.description: The numeric order in which to display the category.

display_type.description: How the category should be displayed

image_url.description: URL of the category image, if set.

dynamic.description: True if this is a dynamic category. Dynamic categories are populated with custom packages per-basket using the Add Dynamic Packages endpoint, and their packages can only be fetched by providing a `basketIdent`.

type.description: The type of payment, either `single` for one-time payments or `subscription`.

revenue_share.description: An array of payment destination objects describing how the purchase should be split between multiple wallets. **Only available with pre-agreement from Tebex.**

is_recurring.description: Whether this package is a recurring (subscription) purchase.

amount.description: A float (decimal) value representing the amount of this payment in your account currency that is credited to the `wallet_ref`

gateway_fee_percent.description: A float (decimal) value representing the percentage of the gateway fee that should be dedicated from this wallet’s revenue share. This optional value can be anywhere between 0 - 100.

username_id.description: The user's username ID. For Steam, this is a numeric representation of their Steam64ID

active.description: True if the tier is currently active.

recurring_payment_reference.description: The ID of the recurring payment this tier is attached to.

next_payment_date.description: The date and time of the next payment for this tier.

name.description: A file name for the media, if applicable.

url.description: The URL of the package media.

featured.description: True if this media should be featured more prominently than others.

primary.description: True if this is the primary media for the package.

username.description: The username of the authenticated customer the packages are being created for.

category_id.description: The ID of the dynamic category to populate.
